New in Sentinel 1.20.0 Argus

Your colour, your theme, and every choice in one place.

Every change in this version

Look

  • Choose a colour: gold, rose, amethyst, sapphire, teal or platinum. It colours the app, live scanning, warnings, the corner island, the tray icon and the companion. Red, orange and yellow always keep their meaning.
  • Light, dark or Auto, set once for the app, live scanning, warning cards and the companion. The corner island stays dark.
  • Signed in, your theme and colour follow you to your other devices.
  • Try Sentinel's colours on the home page. It returns to gold when you move on.
  • One shield and helmet mark for every icon, the installer and emails.

Settings and choices

  • Settings: every choice in one place, in clear groups, with a search.
  • Animation: Full, Calm or Off, plus a separate switch for the scan effect during delicate scanning. If your computer asks for less motion, Sentinel follows.
  • Simple view: fewer pages and words, the answer first in bigger type, details one press away.
  • Marks beside links: every link, risky links, or serious only.
  • Pop-up warnings: always, danger only, or never. The page is still marked.
  • Text size (Standard, Large, Larger) and spacing (Comfortable, Compact).
  • A short first-run step for the main choices.

Clearer help

  • Hover a flagged mark to see why, in one plain sentence, in the Windows app and the companion.
  • Loading, error and offline states that say what happened and offer Try again.
  • Your data: download a copy or delete your account.
  • Help: what changed, report a false alarm, contact.

Browser companion

  • The companion follows your colour and theme in Chrome and Firefox.

Security

  • Electron 44.10.2.
  • A limit on two-factor guesses across attempts.
  • Release workflows pinned to exact versions.
  • Fixes to Defense's folder exemption and the own-site check.
